title: Comparison of Two Porcine Collagen Membranes Combined with rhBMP-2 and rhBMP-9 on Osteoblast Behavior in Vitro
authors: Fujioka-Kobayashi M, Schaler B, Shirakata Y, Nakamura T, Noguchi K, Zhang Y, Miron RJ. 2017 . Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants.; 32(4):e221-e230.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results from this study suggest that both porcine-derived collagen membranes combined with rhBMP -9 accelerated the osteopromotive potential of ST2 cells. Interestingly, rhBMP-9 demonstrated additional osteogenic differentiation compared with rhBMP-2 and may serve as a suitable growth factor for future clinical use” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
